PreToolUse.description: 战略压缩建议：Edit/Write 超过阈值时提醒 compact

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json; p='.claude/dev-flow.json'; d=json.load(open(p)); d['stats']['filesModified']=d['stats'].get('filesModified',0)+1; json.dump(d,open(p,'w'),indent=2); c=d['stats']['filesModified']; print(f'📊 文件修改 {c} 次' + (' — 建议运行 /dev-flow check' if c>=5 else ''))"

PreToolUse.description: 文件修改计数：.py 文件修改 ≥5 次时建议验证

hooks.command: echo '📋 新增 src/ 函数? 先检查 FUNC_CATALOG.md:'; grep -i "$(echo "$CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_PATH" | sed 's/.*\///' | sed 's/\.py$//')" FUNC_CATALOG.md 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo '  (catalog not found, run: python3 generate_func_catalog.py)'

PreToolUse.description: 写入 src/ 文件时提醒查看已有函数目录

hooks.command: echo '🔔 UI 文件已修改 — 建议运行 python3 gui_integrity_check.py'

hooks.command: find . -type d -name __pycache__ -not -path './.venv/*' -not -path './venv/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -type f -name '*.pyc' -delete 2>/dev/null; python3 generate_func_catalog.py; echo '---'; python3 targeted_verify.py 2>&1
